# mini-three-adapter

> A modern TypeScript-first, ESM, zero-global-pollution Three.js adapter for WeChat Mini Games / Mini Programs. Build-time AST rewriting redirects third-party browser globals into a scoped object; runtime patches the single wx canvas in place and exposes one disposable MiniThreeRuntime. MIT licensed, no runtime dependency on three.

## Source entry points

- [src/index.ts](./src/index.ts): umbrella exports.
- [src/scope.ts](./src/scope.ts): MiniThreeScope, getActiveScope, installGlobals (target of the injected plugin import).
- [src/core/runtime.ts](./src/core/runtime.ts): createRuntime, MiniThreeRuntime, lifecycle.
- [src/core/platform.ts](./src/core/platform.ts): PlatformBinding contract.
- [src/core/pointer.ts](./src/core/pointer.ts): touch -> pointer event state machine.
- [src/core/element.ts](./src/core/element.ts): in-place DOM patching + Symbol.hasInstance registry.
- [src/core/canvas.ts](./src/core/canvas.ts): canvas patching, context cache, WebGL normalization.
- [src/build/scope-rewrite.ts](./src/build/scope-rewrite.ts): Babel-based global rewriting.
- [src/build/plugin-core.ts](./src/build/plugin-core.ts): Rollup/Vite plugin core.
- [src/build/assets.ts](./src/build/assets.ts): worker/wasm collection and manifest.
- [src/platforms/wechat-game.ts](./src/platforms/wechat-game.ts): mini game entry.
- [src/platforms/wechat-miniprogram.ts](./src/platforms/wechat-miniprogram.ts): mini program entry.
- [src/platforms/browser.ts](./src/platforms/browser.ts): H5 / Node test platform.
- [package.json](./package.json): exports map, scripts, peers.
- [tsup.config.ts](./tsup.config.ts): two build targets (es2019 runtime / node18 tooling).

## Tests and examples

- [tests/runtime.test.ts](./tests/runtime.test.ts): canvas patching, scope, touch bridge, disposal.
- [tests/scope-rewrite.test.ts](./tests/scope-rewrite.test.ts): AST correctness.
- [tests/polyfills.test.ts](./tests/polyfills.test.ts): event/blob/url/network.
- [tests/plugin.test.ts](./tests/plugin.test.ts): plugin and assets.
- [tests/image-events.test.ts](./tests/image-events.test.ts): native image onload/onerror bridge + decode.
- [tests/event-dispatch.test.ts](./tests/event-dispatch.test.ts): listener `this` / event.target / currentTarget resolve to the host element.
- [tests/capabilities.test.ts](./tests/capabilities.test.ts): context probing fallback, screen-canvas identity guard (candidate set), webgl2Source.
- [tests/scope.test.ts](./tests/scope.test.ts): placeholder scope before a runtime (environment globals read as undefined, early-read reporting).
- [tests/helpers/mock-wx.ts](./tests/helpers/mock-wx.ts): injectable wx simulator.
- [examples/README.md](./examples/README.md): three runnable targets (mini game / mini program / H5).
